sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities. sources.snippet: The Qwen3-4B is a state-of-the-art multilingual base language model with 4 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics. This is based on the implementation of Qwen3-4B found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices.
